name: Gals Fiction -Festival-
original_name: ギャルズフィクション‐Festival‐
source:
A month had passed since Hatsune arrived at the academy. Summer vacation was over, and a new school term had begun.

Just as Hatsune's classmates were beginning to get used to his appearance - having initially been startled by it - Mana's mother, Garakuta Kanade, arrived at the academy as a newly appointed teacher. As an active cosplayer, Kanade took over as the fashion club's advisor, replacing Ririka.

With membership growing and the threat of disbandment behind them, everything seemed to be going perfectly... or so it seemed. Hatsune and the others had no idea what was coming.

A new storm of romance was brewing!

The heroines were becoming bolder than ever, each pursuing Hatsune relentlessly!!

Spurred on by this, Mana realizes her feeling for Hatsune, and Tsukune, Ririka, and even newcomer Kanade join the fray. The battle for love enters the Sengoku era!

What fate awaits Hatsune?!

[Translated from the [url=https://galsfiction-festival.j-studio.net/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
初音转入这所学园已过去了一个月。暑假结束，新学期正式拉开帷幕。

正当同班同学们渐渐习惯了初音最初曾令众人惊愕不已的装扮时，真鱼的母亲——我乐多奏作为新任教师来到了学园。身为现役Coser的奏接替莉莉香，出任时尚社的新任顾问老师。

随着社员人数稳步增加、废社危机彻底解除，一切似乎都顺风顺水……表面上看确实如此。然而初音等人浑然不知前方正有怎样的风暴在等待着他们。

一场全新的恋爱风暴正在悄然酝酿！

女主角们的攻势变得前所未有地大胆，个个对初音展开了猛烈追求！！

受此刺激，真鱼终于意识到了自己对初音的心意，筑音、莉莉香，甚至连新来的奏老师也纷纷参战。这场恋爱争夺战正式迈入群雄逐鹿的战国时代！

等待着初音的究竟会是怎样的命运？！

[译自[url=https://galsfiction-festival.j-studio.net/#story]官方网站[/url]]
